summary: Matternet, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement updating its Form S-1 resale registration with a September 28, 2026 Form 8-K. The supplement covers up to 51,590,925 shares held by selling stockholders, comprising PIPE shares, merger shares, bridge shares and warrants, placement-agent warrants, legacy warrants, retained pre-merger shares, and advisor shares from the May 22, 2026 de-SPAC-style merger with Legacy Matternet. Matternet receives no proceeds from resales, only potential warrant exercise cash. Shares trade OTCQB under MTTN. This is a routine resale registration update, not a new special situation.
